question: In 2019, which mission - mode water conservation campaign was launched for water - stressed districts regarding awareness and improvement of water conservation interventions?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jal Shakti Abhiyan.**____** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The Jal Shakti Abhiyan **was launched by the Ministry of Jal Shakti in 2019.**It is a campaign for water conservation and water security in the country through a collaborative effort of various ministries of the Government of India and state governments.
 
• The focus of the** campaign is on water-stressed districts and blocks**. The **important water conservation interventions** are Water conservation and rainwater harvesting, Renovation of traditional.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Rural Water Supply and Environmental Sanitation Project **(the Swajal project) **has main development objectives: to deliver sustainable health and hygiene benefits to the rural population through improvements in water supply and environmental sanitation services.
 
• **National Rural Drinking Water Programme (NRDWP) was launched in 2009.** It aims to provide safe and adequate water for drinking, cooking and other domestic needs to every rural person on a sustainable basis. 
 
• **Jal Jeevan Mission** is envisioned to provide safe and adequate drinking water through individual household tap connections** by 2024 t**o all households in rural India.
